description: Start a durable eBay crosslisting task for 1–100 imported FLUF products on one owned account. Confirm products, account, daily attempt cap and expiry with the seller before sending confirmed: true. Work continues after chat closes. Accepted is not live: poll get_crosslisting_tasks. Requires a write-enabled API token.

confirmed.description: Must be true only after the seller approves the exact products, eBay account, daily attempt limit and expiry.

daily_limit.description: Maximum publish attempts per task per UTC day (1–100).

product_ids.description: Imported FLUF product IDs, from fluf_id in list_products. Not vids.

name: start_crosslisting_task
